File: src/i18n/index.ts

Update the Accept-Language header parser in src/i18n/index.ts to correctly respect quality value (q-factor) weights instead of blindly taking the first supported language in comma-separated list order.
args.title: Respect quality weights when parsing Accept-Language header
Reject non-integer values in int config parsing in src/config.ts
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

Update the int function in src/config.ts to reject non-integer values like '12h' instead of silently truncating them via Number.parseInt.

File: docs/API.md

Add password length requirements (between 10 and 200 characters) to the POST /auth/password-reset/confirm endpoint documentation in docs/API.md to match the validation enforced by resetConfirmSchema in src/api/auth.ts.
args.title: Document password length requirements for POST /auth/password-reset/confirm in docs/API.md

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/i18n/index.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The current implementation parses the Accept-Language header by splitting on commas and picking the first matching locale, which ignores q weights entirely. We need to update the parser to take quality value (q-factor) weights into account so that user preferences are respected accurately.

label: bug
file: src/config.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The int function in src/config.ts uses Number.parseInt(raw, 10), which parses '12h' as 12 without error, causing TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES=12h to be interpreted as 12 minutes. We should update the int function or token configuration parsing in src/config.ts to reject non-integer values (like '12h') or support duration strings instead of silently truncating via Number.parseInt.

label: docs
file: docs/API.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The API documentation for the password reset confirmation endpoint currently omits the password length requirements. We should update docs/API.md to specify that passwords must be between 10 and 200 characters long, as enforced by resetConfirmSchema in src/api/auth.ts.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Issue #4414 requests a name filter for the saved reports list to avoid paging through hundreds of reports. We will update src/api/reports.ts and src/db/repos/reportRepo.ts to add name filtering and search parameter support to the reports listing endpoint and repository method.
